# Flinote

> Flinote is a free AI-powered study platform used by over 10,000 students worldwide. It converts lectures, PDFs, YouTube videos, and audio recordings into organized notes, flashcards, quizzes, mind maps, and podcasts.

## Key Features

- AI-generated notes from PDFs, audio, video, and web links
- Automatic flashcard and quiz generation for spaced repetition
- AI chat — ask questions about your study content
- Mind map visualization of key concepts
- AI podcast generation from notes
- Support for 50+ languages
- Works on web, iOS, and Android

## Target Audience

Students, learners, and professionals who want to study more efficiently.

## Pricing

- Free plan: 1 note with all features
- Pro plan: Unlimited notes, starting at $19/month or $89/year
